summary.headline: Diurnal Nativity with Cancer Ascending
summary.text: Interpretation of a diurnal nativity with Cancer ascending: the Sun and Mercury are in Aries, Jupiter and Moon in Cancer, Saturn in Pisces, Venus in Taurus, and Mars in Scorpio. The Sun and Jupiter, first and second lords of the Sun’s triplicity, occupy angles and their exaltations, signifying sublimity, fortune, resources, good fame, and praise.
